name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: Global composite PMI 53.2 in October, down from 54.3 but above the 51 Watch line; November flashes due 23 Nov
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI fell to 53.2 in October from 54.3 in September, its first decline in seven months, as growth eased amid heightened economic uncertainty (S&P Global, 5 Nov). That is well above the 51 Watch line. November flash PMIs for the euro area, UK and US had not been published as of 22 Nov and are due on 23 Nov.
for_you: Global business activity is still expanding, though more slowly. Manufacturers and exporters face softer but positive demand; the 23 Nov flash figures will show whether the slowdown deepened.

sources.title: S&P Global — Global PMI remains elevated in October but dips on heightened economic uncertainty

why: Purchasing-manager surveys are the fastest read on whether the world economy is expanding or contracting.
drivers: Orders, inventories, trade policy, energy costs, credit conditions.
